sections.title: Words for success
sections.content:
Vocabulary for talking about achievements:
• accomplish — achieve something successfully. She accomplished all her goals before turning 30.
• thrive — grow and develop well. Small businesses thrive when the economy is strong.
• breakthrough — an important discovery or development. Scientists made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
• excel — be exceptionally good at something. She excels in mathematics and physics.
• milestone — an important event or stage. Graduating from university was a major milestone.

sections.title: Words for failure
sections.content:
Describing setbacks and difficulties:
• setback — a problem that delays progress. The project suffered a major setback when funding was cut.
• downfall — a loss of power or success. Greed was the cause of his downfall.
• undermine — weaken gradually. Constant criticism can undermine a person's confidence.
• fall short — fail to reach a standard. The results fell short of expectations.
• obstacle — something that blocks progress. Lack of funding is the biggest obstacle to growth.

exercises.question: An important discovery that opens new possibilities is a:
exercises.explanation: A breakthrough is a sudden, important development or discovery.

exercises.question: To gradually weaken someone's confidence or position is to:
exercises.explanation: Undermine means to damage or weaken something gradually.

exercises.question: When results don't meet expectations, they:
exercises.explanation: Fall short means to fail to reach a desired standard or level.

exercises.question: A significant event marking an important stage in development is a:
exercises.hint: A key point in a journey.
exercises.explanation: A milestone is a significant stage or event in the development of something.

exercises.question: Something that blocks your path to success is an:
exercises.explanation: An obstacle is something that blocks progress or makes it difficult.

exercises.question: To grow and develop successfully is to:
exercises.explanation: Thrive means to prosper, flourish, and grow vigorously.

exercises.question: The cause of someone's ruin or loss of power is their:
exercises.explanation: Downfall is a loss of power, prosperity, or status.

exercises.question: To be exceptionally good at a particular activity is to:
exercises.explanation: Excel means to be exceptionally good at or proficient in something.
